plainSummary: All required checks affect the verdict, and failed reports remain readable through both client transports.
summary: Ran node --test packages/ledger/dist/verify/aggregation.break.test.js with loopback permission: 4 tests passed, no skips. 152 mixed-evidence permutations preserve fail > missing > attested > pass; duplicate keys are rejected including agreeing and unreferenced duplicates; malformed locators/invalid result values stay missing. Actual production buildRoutes behind a temporary HTTP server plus both client transports deliver failed verify/report/snapshot data. ecf77633-290a-84dd-975e-10688aeff2b8 F-01 is resolved after snapshot route changed to HTTP 200 with report.ok:false. Prior-HEAD verifier was separately transpiled into an isolated dist copy; all three aggregation groups failed before fixes. Breaker changed only its new test and review artifacts.
